name: synthetic-data-core
description: Pure tooling for synthetic health data: a story model (people, prescriptions, fills, lab draws) with every date derived from one as-of date, deterministic seeded ids, and one renderer per source — the Rexall Be Well HAR, the Shoppers Drug Mart family-account HAR, lab results as the LifeLabs import makes them, filed on the person's pharmacy Patient, FHIR Sync for Pebble's Observations of a day-by-day physiology, and a de-identified DICOM image re-identified for a story and read through the DICOM importer; plus the published data set's layout (fhir/<Type>/<id>.json, static files linked from their source-file DocumentReferences) and its index.json manifest schema. The stories themselves live in wildflowerhealthio/synthetic-data. No DOM, no fs, no React.
